title.narrative: Capacity Building and International Cooperation

description.narrative: One of the key mandates of the GGGI Doha Office is to facilitate multidirectional learning and capacity building on green growth among local stakeholders. As such, the project involves the delivery of activities aimed at knowledge sharing and capacity building that include, but not limited to, trainings, secondments, internships, exchange programs, forums, etc.

This project aims to equip local stakeholders with the required shift in mindset, as well as skills and tools to design and implement green growth initiatives in support of Qatar’s vision of achieving a knowledge-based sustainable economy. Key considerations will be given to women and youth to prepare them for bigger roles in nation building.
